method: Actual full desktop/mobile screenshots inspected in six four-context sheets, with independent accepted-PNG comparisons. DOM checks and RGB match evidence are supporting evidence, not the semantic review.
mobile_scope: Primary relationships and labels are recognizable inline; fine secondary information may use the unchanged enlargement control. No universal tiny-text readability claim.

targets.expected_alt_text: Watercolor specimen aperture, asymmetric held-out sequence and separate open proposal frame. An indigo actual-token leader identifies the held-out target while a second leader identifies the predicted cell inside an enlarged comparison aperture. A visibly open coral proposal boundary is separate from the different-dataset stacks, excluded post-training layers and unknown-floor note. At 320px the prediction comparison and proposed boundary remain visible; fine secondary distinctions are clearer full-size.

targets.expected_alt_text: Graphite engraving exposes a broad shared-layer cutaway, dual passes and two cache strata. The engraved shared middle section carries visibly separate First pass and Second pass ribbons. Output attaches to the lower second-pass level, rather than an independent upper exit. A narrow Local window is visibly distinct from the broader Shared context slab. At 320px the shared section, two pass terms and output remain readable; fine gate hatching is full-size detail.

targets.expected_alt_text: Green and ochre paper folds converge from two contribution channels into one large total. Exact $93.5B and $26.0B amounts meet the $119.5B total, with Before fees detached underneath. At 320px the two contributions and combined total are readable; issuer detail benefits from full-size viewing.

At right, the waveform, separated consent term and unresolved case file distinguish allegation from a judgment. The case-scope limitation remains visible at 320px.

targets.expected_alt_text: Cobalt and terracotta matte ceramic context trays stop at an upright approval partition. Calendar, envelope and meeting-audio context lead into a labeled Draft reply that waits at a plain approval partition. Only the authorized side carries the changed document and its action record, whose Approver value explicitly reads User. The approval distinction and attribution remain visible at 320px; no real identity, control knob or product screenshot is asserted.

Redirect uses a rounded nondirectional return guide; Stop has a blunt end. The five fields and three choices remain readable at 320px without invented work records.
